Mr. Pan Kung Chan, Chief of the local Bureau of
social Affairs, was summoned to Nanking, he was instructed
by Mr. Chen Lih-fu, Chairman of the Standing Committee of
the Kuomintang, to carry out :-

That as a course of national defence will be intro-
duced in the curriculum of schools, beginning from the Autumn
semester, arrangements should be made to send the heads of
educational institutions and officers in charge of moral training
departments of the institutions, instructors of volunteer corps
and boyscouts and teachers of character reading schools, who
are below the age of 45, to Kuling to receive a course in
national defence and another one in political education for
a period of three weeks.

In connection with above, a course of national defence
is to be introduced in the curricula of all schools in Shanghai,
commencing with the autumn semester. Principals and moral
training department heads of universities, middle and primary
schools, instructors of volunteer corps and boyscouts and
teachers of character reading schools who are below the age
of 45, should be sent to Kuling on July 1 to receive courses of
national defence and political science, for a period of three weeks
in order to enable them to teach their students.

On account of this instruction, Mr. Pan Kung Chan
called a meeting on June 13 of heads of schools at the Suchow

inaugurated, the duty of which is to instil knowledge of
national defence into the minds of students.

摘自 D.S.I. Coyne 于 1937 年 6 月 26 日提交的报告，
内容涉及来自中方渠道关于劳资纠纷的情报 - 档案号 D.6449

当地社会局局长潘公展先生被召往南京，他受国民党
常务委员会主席陈立夫先生指示，执行以下事项：

作为国防课程的一部分，将从秋季学期开始在学校课
程中引入国防教育。应安排各教育机构负责人、各校训育
处主任、义勇队及童子军教官以及识字学校教师中年龄在
45 岁以下者，前往牯岭接受为期三周的国防课程及政治教
育课程。

鉴于上述指示，上海所有学校的课程中也将自秋季学
期起引入国防课程。大学、中学及小学的校长和训育处主
任、义勇队及童子军教官以及识字学校教师中年龄在 45 岁
以下者，应于 7 月 1 日前往牯岭，接受为期三周的国防及
政治学课程，以便使其能够向学生授课。

由于此项指示，潘公展先生于 6 月 13 日在苏州公会
召集各学校负责人开会，期间成立了“中国特种教育协会”，
其职责是向学生灌输国防知识。

据悉，约有 180 名学校负责人、义勇队及童子军教
官以及识字学校教师

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL [POLICE]
File No. B: REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 7954
Date June 6 37
Date June 15, 1937.

Subject China Special Education Association - new body formed

Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

A new body known as the "China Special Education Association"
(中國特種教育協會) was inaugurated at a meeting held at
2.30 p.m. June 13 in the Huchow Guild, 263 Kweichow Road, when
approximately two hundred and forty persons, including Mr. Pan
Kung-chan, Commissioner of the Bureau of Social Affairs, attended
with Dr. Herman C.E.Liu, Principal of the University of Shanghai,
presiding. After the passing of a number of resolutions
relating to the publication of booklets dealing with special
education, etc., an executive committee of thirty six members and
a supervisory committee of thirty persons, composed of presidents
and principals of local universities and middle schools, were
elected. A standing committee composed of the following
persons was also elected :-

Mr. Pan Kung-chan (潘公展), Commissioner of the Bureau
of Social Affairs (Chairman).
Mr. Ho Ping-soong (何炳松), President of the Chinese
University, Chenju.
Mr. Ou Yuan-hwei (歐元懷), President of the Great China
University.
(劉湛恩)
Dr. Herman C.E.Liu, President of the University of Shanghai.
Mr. Owng Ts-leong (翁之龍), President of the Doong Chi
University, Woosung.
Mr. Woo Man-hai (吳南軒), President of the Fuh Tan
University, Kiangwan.
Mr. Hsu Sing-chu (許性初), Principal of the Sing
Loh Normal School, Poetung.
Mr. Chow Zang (周尚), an expert attached to the Bureau
of Social Affairs.

上海公共租界 [警务处]

日期 1937 年 6 月 6 日
日期 1937 年 6 月 15 日。

主题 中国特种教育协会 - 新成立之团体

由 D.I. Sih Tse-liang 制作 经 J. Boyne D.S.I. 转呈

一个名为“中国特种教育协会” (中國特種教育協會) 的新团体于 6 月 13 日下午 2 时 30 分在贵州路 263 号湖州公会举行的会议上正式成立，约二百四十人出席，包括社会局局长潘公展先生，会议由沪江大学校长刘湛恩博士主持。在通过若干关于出版涉及特种教育的小册子等决议后，选举产生了由当地大学和中学的校长及院长组成的三十六人执行委员会和三十人监察委员会。还选举产生了由下列人员组成的常务委员会：

潘公展先生 (潘公展)，社会局局长（主席）。
何炳松先生 (何炳松)，大夏大学校长。
欧元怀先生 (歐元懷)，大夏大学校长。
(劉湛恩)
刘湛恩博士 (Herman C.E.Liu)，沪江大学校长。
翁之龙先生 (翁之龍)，吴淞同济大学校长。
吴南轩先生 (吳南軒)，江湾复旦大学校长。
许性初先生 (許性初)，宝通辛罗师范学校校长。
周尚先生 (周尚)，社会局专家。
陶百川先生 (陶百川)，党部委员

June 7, 1937.

The Police Headquarters,
S. M. P.

Gentlemen:

This Federation is organized under the auspices
of the members of the educational circle with the object
of studying the ways and means for enforcement of education.
It has been decided that its inauguration meeting will be
held at 1 p.m. on the 13th inst. at Hu Zoo, Kweichow Road.
Apart from requesting the Kuomintang and the Administrative
authorities of this Municipality to detail officers to
give us directions we have to write to you with the
request that you will take note of same andafford us
necessary protection, thus obliging.

Chow Zang

Chairman of the Preparatory
Committee of Special Education
Federation of China c/o the Bureau
of Social Affairs of Shanghai.
